This '''prison''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rutan/Legends|Rutan]].<ref name="TSP">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Shattered Peace]]''</ref>

Sometime in [[45 BBY/Legends|45 BBY]], [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Leed]] was forced to spend a night in the prison when he angered his father, [[King/Legends|King]] [[Frane]], by insisting that he wanted to stay in [[Senali]] instead of assuming the throne. During his stay in the prison, Leed discovered a flaw in the prison's sensors. He was able to use this flaw a year later when he, along with his friend [[Drenna]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], infiltrated the prison to rescue the imprisoned [[Yaana]], the daughter of Senali's king, [[Meenon]].<ref name="TSP" />
